course.title: Environmental Planning and Management
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value:
If you are assigned to a project as an Environment Planner and you have to (15)   
design mitigation measure for “Rupsa Textile Industry”. The textile industry   
emitted toxic waste including caustic soda, sulphides, acetic acid, metallic   
salts, starch. Under some following condition design, a mitigation measure   
following “Mitigation Measure Hierarchy"   
1. Area is a suburban area   
2. Industry is near settlement   
3. Beside a river   
4. Soil type of project site is less compact. x
